alt: 玩具飛機卡在低樹枝上，孩子身旁放著試過的短木棍、網子和紙管，現在正與同伴合力改用長桿和小籃子。
scene_prompt: One child persistently tries several different safe ways to retrieve a toy airplane caught on a LOW garden branch: on the grass lie a failed short stick, a little hand net and a cardboard reaching tube; now the child carefully combines a longer pole with a basket while another child holds it steady. The stuck plane remains visible. The sequence of discarded different attempts and the new thoughtful method must be obvious, no ladders or risky climbing.
